dynamic.description:
Where the language computes a name at run time in a way that could reach the symbol,
as `file:line` (at most ten); such access lowers the confidence.

file.description: The file that defines the symbol.

module.description: The namespace of the module the file belongs to.

module_files.description: Every file of that module; no file outside the module imports any of them.

reach.description:
What found it unreachable: `module` when no import or root reaches its module,
`references` when its module is reachable but nothing names the symbol.

suspect_imports.description: Unresolved or external imports whose specifier names this file, which may load it.

findings.summary: A symbol in a module that nothing imports, that exports nothing, and that holds no entry point, test, or framework hook; or a symbol that is no root and that no reference outside its own body names.

metrics.name: dead_symbols
metrics.summary: The number of dead.symbol findings in scope.

metrics.name: dead_exports
metrics.summary: The number of dead.export findings in scope.

manifest.summary: Symbols and exports in modules that no import reaches and no entry point, test, or framework hook keeps alive, then symbols that nothing outside their own body names. Limitation: references match by name, not by type, so any same-named reference keeps a symbol alive, and a function only dead code calls is reported once that code is gone; an export of an unimported module is only `dead.export` (info, low confidence) (ADR-058, ADR-135).
